scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dental/shared build && pnpm --filter @dental/api build && pnpm --filter @dental/web build
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @dental/shared test:cov && pnpm --filter @dental/api test:cov && pnpm --filter @dental/web test:cov
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:strict && pnpm --filter @dental/shared test && pnpm --filter @dental/api arch:check && pnpm --filter @dental/api test && pnpm --filter @dental/web test
scripts.verify:delivery: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:strict && pnpm --filter @dental/api arch:check && pnpm build && pnpm test:cov
scripts.verify:critical: pnpm lint:strict && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @dental/api arch:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
